content.text:
I fixed all three problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` passes (8 of 8, including 6 new regression tests).

- **Hang after a failure:** a rejected job never decremented `running` or started the next job, so the queue stalled. A job that threw synchronously or returned a plain value also broke the old code. Every outcome now frees its slot and starts the next job.
- **`onIdle()` resolving too early:** it only checked that nothing was pending. It now also waits until nothing is running.
- **One job at a time after `pause()`/`resume()`:** `next()` started at most one job per call. It now loops until every free slot is filled, so `resume()` fills all four slots at concurrency 4.

The new tests in `test/queue.test.js` cover each of these cases:
- A failing job rejects only itself.
- Synchronous throws and plain return values are handled.
- `onIdle()` waits for running jobs.
- `onIdle()` resolves immediately when the queue is idle.
- `onIdle()` resolves after a failing last job.
- `resume()` runs four jobs at once at concurrency 4.

I didn't run the new tests against the old code to confirm they fail there.

I haven't committed anything.
